string.text: Ukrainian-made semi-automatic pistol, developed and manufactured by RPC Fort. "Fort-17" is a modification of "Fort-12" pistol with a polymer frame made of fiberglass reinforced shock-resistant polyamide with a detachable grip that allows for better fit. Equipped with a Picatinny rail, which allows installation of tactical accessories, like laser sight or flashlight. Use of polymers allowed decrease weight and manufacturing costs.
